The hook now forwards the supplied signal to `getShare` and returns `false` when either unavailable flag is set. The focused test is still running; the existing default-share tests remain in place.
Jest is still processing the Drive test setup. The source changes are limited to the hook and its focused test, and `git diff --check` passed.
